title: NFL execs — including chief medical officer — blast ‘uninformed speculation’ on Jalen Hurts blood clot drama

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: NFL execs — including chief medical officer — blast ‘uninformed speculation’ on Jalen Hurts blood clot drama
sources.description: Hurts originally was revealed to have played through a superficial blood clot. The diagnosis was modified this week to deep vein thrombosis in his left leg and bilateral pulmonary emboli.
